notes.purpose: The plain drawer for one pig: one Measure and her last weight as anchor.
rules: Record commits on the spot; the drawer drops. The primary states the value ("Record 182 kg").

notes.purpose: Five pigs on one sheet, no batch submit.

elements.name: Running list
elements.rule: Each confirm writes at once. Tapping a line reopens that pig as an edit, never a second record. Skip records nothing and skipped pigs are re-offered once at the end; leaving early keeps every confirmed record.

rules: The header counts position (3 of 5); the next-hint lives in the running list.

notes.purpose: Total versus sample is a value of n, not a mode.

elements.name: kg and head
elements.shows: Scale reading, head on the scale, Next load and the live average
elements.logic: Record writes one population record {sum kg, n, average, headcount at record, who, when}. Whole pen is n = headcount, so there is no toggle.
elements.rule: n is mandatory: the feed spot-check needs a per-head average. Next load banks a pair; nothing is written until Record.

notes.purpose: The pen sheet already updated in place.
rules: The record shows as a fact line under BODY beside the count trail; no result screen, no toast.
edge: For untagged head the count is the identity, so the weight line and the count trail sit together.
